senses.gloss: ch. same, to be hot, dark, black.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 30:30">Targ. Job XXX, 30</cite> (h. text <he>שחר</he>).—Part. pass. <cite ref="U00673"><he>שְׁחִים</he></cite> (v. <cite ref="U00620"><he>שְׁחוּם</he></cite>); pl. <he>שְׁחִימִין</he>, <he>שְׁחִימֵי</he>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 2:7">Targ. Y. Gen. II, 7</cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 6:16">Targ. Job VI, 16</cite> (h. text <he>הקדרים</he>).—

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 96b:5">B. Kam. 96ᵇ</cite> <he>ש׳ ועבדינהו חדתי</he> (Ms. M. <he>שחמי</he>) if the coins were black (tarnished), and he (who stole them) made them look new again; <he>חדתי ועבדינהו ש׳</he> if they were new, and he made them black.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 33b:8">Ab. Zar. 33ᵇ</cite> <he>הני חצבי ש׳ וכ׳</he> the jugs of gentiles made of dark clay.
Ḥull. 55ᵇ משיכלי שחי׳ Ms. M. (Ar. שחמי, ed. שיחומי) dark-glazed basins, opp. חיורי (opin. quoted in Rashi: bronze basins).
